items.Sentence: Existing plant operations and processes include preliminary treatment with bar screening and grit removal
All drains within the existing plant boundary convey stormwater flows to the treatment plant headworks
primary treatment with primary sedimentation tanks
secondary treatment with trickling filters and secondary sedimentation
disinfection with sodium hypochlorite, and dechlorination with sodium bisulfite
Planned Facility operations and processes are anticipated to include an equalization basin for storage of instantaneous peak flows
secondary treatment by means of a membrane bioreactor (MBR), consisting of activated sludge biological process basins and submerged membrane filtration trains
Effluent recycled for use onsite or distributed to other users will be chlorinated
pumped to a constructed wetland adjacent to the new treatment plant for polishing treatment
